entities.summary: Bulanık, formerly Gop or Kop, is a town in Muş Province, in the Eastern Anatolian region of Turkey. It is the seat of Bulanık District. Bulanık was elected from the DEM Party in the 2024 Turkish Local Elections, with Aryan Doğan serving as the mayor. According to the 2024 population census, the district's total population is 70,568.
